correctness.rationale: For r>=2 deleting the hub leaves disjoint edges and hence a simplex; the hub link obeys the exact component-size inequality. Faces omitting some near vertex form a good cover by cones with simplex nerve. The resulting quotient is an m-fold suspension of a known simplex skeleton (q>0) or the boundary sphere (q=0). The integral relative chains are a sign-twisted truncated Koszul complex with primitive augmentation, whose sole top kernel is exterior^q of the integral augmentation lattice. Thirty independently enumerated mod-two chain tests and 1438 signed Lefschetz-character tests passed; these corroborate but do not replace the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The minimal natural move from a fully whiskered star to removing its central whisker changes the whole binomial sphere-multiplicity sequence, despite earlier full-whiskering classifications. The theorem gives an exact two-parameter homotopy phase diagram and determines a torsion-free integral S_m action which Betti numbers do not reveal; this resolves a natural uncomputed class rather than a single arbitrary small case.
